name: Green Bean Casserole
desc: Canned green beans and cream of mushroom soup with cheddar, baked under French fried onions.

source.title: Best Green Bean Casserole
source.evidence: Same four ingredients (canned green beans, condensed cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup cheddar divided, French fried onions) and the same microwave-then-bake method; can sizes differ slightly.

ingredients.raw: 2 (15 oz) cans cut green beans, drained
1 (10.5 oz) can condensed cream of mushroom soup

steps: Stir the green beans and soup together in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high until warm, 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup of the cheese and microwave 2 to 3 minutes more.
Spread the mixture in a 2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup cheese, then the fried onions.
Bake until the cheese melts and the onions are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
tips: Allrecipes' version uses a 6 oz can of fried onions for a thicker topping.
